title: Position privacy resources absent: /config/privacy, /config/privacy/allowed, oscore_required body; group-mode encrypted beacons (spec 18.2.4)
description: Spec 12-apps.md 18.2.4: unauthenticated queries to non-public nodes receive 4.01 Unauthorized with CBOR body {error: oscore_required, mode: ...}; in group mode position beacons are encrypted with the group OSCORE key and sent to the ff35 group multicast; private mode whitelist configured via PUT /config/privacy/allowed {peers: [...]}; only whitelisted peers OSCORE-protected queries are answered. Classification: divergent/not-implemented. Evidence: response codes exist (C coap_location.c:1238-1241 observe, :1325-1328 cache; Py position_privacy.py:31-94; vectors position_privacy_auth.json) but the spec error body exists only in deaddrop (Py deaddrop.py:593) and groups (groups_collection.py:155-157), not position; no /config/privacy or /config/privacy/allowed resource in any stack (grep matches spec only; Py whitelist is a single constructor parameter allowed_peer_iid position_privacy.py:44-50); group mode merely suppresses beacons (C coap_location.c:576-577, suppression test lichen/tests/coap_location_beacon/main.c:373-398) - no ff35 encrypted beacon anywhere; cache accepts group-provenance updates only (coap_location.c:980-981). Suggested placement: lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_config.c + coap_location.c; python/src/lichen/coap/position_privacy.py + resources/site.py. Refs R-12-026, R-12-027, R-12-028.
